title: 从…到… and 在…
explanation: 从…到…  means "from...to..." (spatial or temporal range); 在…  means "at/in/on" a location. Both come before the verb in the Time/Place slot.
structure: Subj + 从 Place 到 Place + Verb / Subj + 在 Place + Verb

examples.pinyin: wǒ cóng běi jīng dào shàng hǎi
examples.english: I go from Beijing to Shanghai.

examples.pinyin: tā cóng bā diǎn gōng zuò dào liù diǎn
wǒ zài tú shū guǎn kàn shū
examples.english: I read books at the library.

examples.pinyin: tā men zài gōng yuán pǎo bù

notes: 从…到…  marks a range (place or time). 在…  marks a static location where an action happens. Both follow the subject in the standard word order.
